name: Olfa Club
description: A Japanese-inspired listening bar with a precision hi-fi system, 40+ wines by the glass, specialist coffee, and a curious focus on mineral water tasting. From the couple behind Long & Short café. No website - they operate via WhatsApp community.
tip: Bring your own vinyl for a needle drop if you want. The mineral water thing sounds odd but try it - each drop tastes like a different place. No official website, join the WhatsApp for events.
